summary: Validated production home, responsive hero, menu/cart, catering blank-email submission, first-admin setup, customer account, frontend build, and backend regression. Core public/customer flows passed, but the required .local admin cannot log in and contact status updates target an unimplemented API route.

critical.issue: Rejects the required test-admin@navyug.local credential with 422 because Login.email uses EmailStr, although /api/admin/setup accepts the same .local address and successfully creates the admin.
No PATCH contact status endpoint exists. Admin UI submits PATCH /api/contact/{id}, so contact status Save will return 405/404 and the requested contact status workflow cannot work.

integration_issues.issue: The setup screen accepts and creates test-admin@navyug.local, but the login form cannot authenticate it because the backend rejects the address before password verification.
The Admin component calls update() for contact, but the backend exposes only GET/POST /api/contact; Save cannot persist a selected status.

action_items: Use a setup/login email type that permits the required .local test credential, or add equivalent normalization/validation consistently to Login and setup.
Implement PATCH /api/contact/{inquiry_id} with admin authorization and status persistence, then retest the admin Messages tab.
Retest admin menu CRUD and order/catering/contact status workflows after admin login is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: Authentication validation is inconsistent: SetupIn.email is str while Login.email is EmailStr, making the documented first-admin credential unusable after successful setup.
Admin.update() assumes every non-order tab has a PATCH route, but server.py has no contact status mutation route.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 existing regression tests; required admin login and contact status probes failed)
success_rate.frontend: 83% (home/mobile/menu-cart/catering/setup/account passed; admin dashboard mutation flow blocked by auth)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed browser customer, cart/order-related test data, catering inquiry, contact inquiry, and first admin test-admin@navyug.local through public flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public and customer flows are passing. Admin setup created the documented admin, but login rejects its .local email; admin menu/status workflows could not be fully exercised until this is fixed. Catering blank email now passes.
rca of the issue: The admin setup model stores any string email and creates the requested .local account. The login model validates email with Pydantic EmailStr, whose current validator rejects reserved .local domains before the handler reaches MongoDB. Separately, Admin.update() constructs /api/contact/{id}, but server.py defines no PATCH handler for contacts, unlike orders and catering.
